# Private adaptive lexical classification profile

Frozen input: `build/cache-editor-product/20261026T045019460982Z/fixture`.
This is an unregistered CPU prototype, not production placement or a native
performance claim. It leaves all released page/link/parent probes immutable.

Run `python3 tests/test_cache_lexical_adaptive.py` from the repository root.
`--build-only` proves the packaged C35, C37 and C21 controls byte-for-byte before
building the changed profiles. `budget.py OUT FIXTURE` is the standalone fit
experiment; its oversized measurement-only images are never imported.

## Executable layout and authority

The private C35 preserves PAGE_REUSE, FORWARD_SEED, COMMITTED_IDENTITY and empty
INLINE hints. Roots admitted are exactly flags1/lexABI0 or flags5/lexABI1; mapped
flags3, combined7 and unknown combinations remain refused. CR bit$10 is admitted
only with lexical capability; all other existing record/source/typed guards stay.

The CRC85-covered page-kind byte is 1 for baseline or $81 for lexical. This is a
**private proof ABI extension**. C35 and C37 explicitly publish the tag; restore
validates low kind1, restores capability from bit7 and normalizes the transient
query page kind to1. C21 capture accepts exactly those two values (a two-byte
mask), retaining the existing source59/AUTH13/full payload proof and VALID-last
publication. No CP_VALID/79-byte parser state is fabricated. Old C20/C39 proof
readers may safely miss tagged proofs; they do not gain lexical authority.
R19's existing outgoing producer checks CRC85/AUTH13 and remains unchanged.

Measured images:

| Image | Original | Private |
|---|---:|---:|
| C35 | 4090 | 4096 |
| C37 | 3636 | 3671 |
| C21 | 4092 | 4094 |

No new BSS, ZP, object or bank. C35's naive4153-byte variant is not executable
within the slot. It fits after equivalent error trampolines, adjacent SOURCE59
plus LENGTH3 copy fusion (source/destination both contiguous), and removal of an
unreachable selector-only RTS. The fusion preserves carry; A/Y/NZ are dead before
the next reference copy. No check is deleted or made less strict.

The earlier private gateway/resolver/fallback and producer/link substitutions
remain, including the admitted production-capacity limitation: C5/C29/R26/R30/
C39 are used production modules and are not free slots. No private IDs are newly
registered here. Parent has separately reserved future C45/R36/R37/C47/C49;
those are not deployed by this release.

## Actual public parent proof

Final run `build/cache-lexical-adaptive/20261026T061512379511Z`: PASS12 frames,
768,000 independent bitmap pixels and12,000 attributes. Real public source,
actual baseline/producer/link, actual double-F4 layout invalidation, actual

Each eligible Full frame has19 cache hits/zero real lexer feeds. Traces show

CRC-valid kind and corrupted CRC each cause real C37→C35 BEGIN recovery, then
correct pixels. Root STOP, changed request B1 cleanup and missing resolver/
consumer strict fallback retain the original public checks.

Whole16MiB is exact outside the existing typedFE source-render ranges
(header64 and0200..EA87); the **entire typed53 allocation is unchanged** during
all parent-render intervals. Canonical source/history/catalog/ReadyOS1024 and

previous reviewed parent release; the two new recovery frames equal the same
Full PNG. No new native or physical-key evidence is claimed.

## Costs and limits

Full BODY998,19 windows: warm4,122,538 instructions/268 loads versus packaged
5,901,542/212, with18,962 baseline lexer feeds. First4,178,423 versus5,957,302.
Producer+link578,811 instructions/16 loads is separate; first including it is
4,757,234 versus5,957,302. These are whole public forced-render costs, not lexer
kernel costs or PAL cycles. More loads despite fewer instructions remain explicit.

Plain3,942,291 versus3,942,291, both50 loads. Markdown2,057,309 versus2,057,889,
both174 loads; its previous generic-classifier regression is eliminated.
Short Full still costs732,456 versus729,273 (one extra load, +3,183 instructions,
0.44%) because this release retains the old C25→C39 fallback gateway topology.
**Do not promote as preserving every ordinary cost.** The next separate stub
probe keeps strict C25 in place and hands only eligible long Full work to C45,
returning MISS to actual C25 op3 without recursion.

This narrow source has one CR page, BASIC BODY998 and root5. The immutable
page/link releases contain their own ASM/large-body/fault scope. This parent
release does not claim mapped3/7 composition, new >64KiB parent coverage,
W_LOAD content-equivalent reuse, edit rebase, full preview or lifecycle proof.
